review_text: My Samsung refrigerator ice maker stopped working. I use this to make ice  for the day. It does a great job. The ice doesn't last as long as regular ice cubes in a glass of liquid but this is convenient to use and cheaper than replacing my refrigerator ice maker.

The ice maker in my freezer broke so I bought this as a replacement.  It's portable enough to take with us on vacation!  I wouldn't try to stuff it in a suitcase, but we put it in the back of the car for a drive to the beach in august and it was a blessing all week!  The "empty water tank" indicator quit working just a few weeks into owning it.  I doesn't just automatically shut off when the water is low... it just keeps trying to pump out these sad, tiny little cubes.  I just try to remember to check it frequently when I'm running it and keep it shut off the rest of the time.  Also something to note, and this applies to all ice makers except for the very expensive kind.... it is NOT a freezer, so your cubes will begin to melt right away.  Make a habit of emptying the basket frequently so your cubes stay frozen!

I was skeptical about this ice machine because we have a similar one at my office and that thing is loud as heck and takes forever to make ice, but this one is great! It's not super loud only when the ice is dropping and makes ice super quick. I usually turn it on when I get home from work and within 1-1.5 hours the basket is full. I love how big the ice cubes are. I will usually let the basket in the machine get full, then transfer that into a bag to put in the freezer and I have enough ice for my coffee in the morning and to put in 2 water bottles. It's fairly small and sits on my coffee stand. I wish I would've pulled the trigger and bought it sooner

review_text: I followed the enclosed instructions and now we have ice again!  I had no issues with the installation of the boards and saved lots of $$$ on labor costs by doing it myself.  The bonus was the cost for the boards found on Amazon was much less than other appliance stores selling the same online...so more $$ saved...Yay ME!
